source: pydantic-ai-harness LoopDetection (PR #336: 5-in-10 repetition, 3 identical results, 3 A-B cycles, 3 near-identical monologues, harness-marked nudge); RICEJOA Jev runaway check (announced action, no tool call, turn ended); fusegate repeat/depth wording; pi-jev failure_class options

promise.en: \b(?:i(?:'ll| will)|let me|let's|now i(?:'ll| will)|next,? i(?:'ll| will)|going to)\s+(?:now\s+)?(?:run|test|check|verify|fix|update|apply|implement|write|edit|add|start|try|build|install|commit|look|read|search|create|re-?run)\b[^?]*[.:…]?\s*$

runaway.instructions: The assistant's turn ended with `final_text` and no tool call. Did it announce a concrete action it would take next (run, edit, test, check) and then stop without taking it? Read `request` for what the user asked.

criteria.true: It said it will do something now and stopped before doing it
criteria.false: It finished, asked the user something, reported a result, or offered an optional next step

failure.instructions: A delegated agent run failed with `output` and is being dispatched again. What kind of failure is `output` reporting?

criteria.transient: A network or resource hiccup that may succeed on a retry
criteria.environment: A missing dependency, port, credential, or tool in the local setup
criteria.code_bug: The code or types are wrong
criteria.permission: Access was denied by the OS or a server
criteria.user_error: The task or call itself was given wrongly
criteria.no_failure: Output reports success or nothing wrong

advice.environment: fix the environment first; the same retry will fail the same way
advice.code_bug: change the code or the task before retrying
advice.permission: do not retry; report the denial
advice.user_error: fix the task text before retrying
advice.no_failure: the earlier run did not fail
